name: emit a per-model metrics table with the required structure
definition: write a delimited table with one row per candidate model and columns naming the model, correlation, error, penalty, and degrees of freedom.
failure_mode: structural errors or fabricated values fail the validations.

name: emit animation data with timelines and keyframes
definition: produce animation records containing per-timeline keyframes with time/translation/rotation/scale fields whose array lengths match declared timeline counts.
failure_mode: mismatch between declared counts and actual arrays fails structural checks
